title: Our brand framework
slide_intent: Separate the museum’s offer, approach, belief, character and values so a team can judge a design or message against a specific principle.
strategic_value: The framework can give staff across venues a common vocabulary for discussing decisions while preserving the range of their collections.
demonstration: Five named groups organize what the museums offer, how they work, what they believe, how they speak and what guides their actions.
practical_value: Choose the relevant group when reviewing an idea, such as using the character list for voice and the values list for an institutional commitment.

content_islands.name: Framework heading
content_islands.spec: Position the section reference and title at upper left.

content_islands.name: Offer, approach and belief
content_islands.spec: Stack these three groups in the first column. Use bold subheads, a short offer and belief statement, and a list of approaches.

content_islands.name: Character and values
content_islands.spec: Place the traits and values in a second column. Keep their descriptions with the bold group headings.
